proves.claim: One sentinel pass run in process with line.tune on and a due cycle makes the one line change flow tune --apply would make, and a pass with the cycle not due makes none.

cli.sentinel.runs-line-tune.why: Without it the line tuner has no cadence of its own and the board's line settings move only when a person runs the apply by hand.

proves.claim: A sentinel pass with line.tune off never runs the tuner, and a tuner refusal is reported in the pass output without failing the pass.

cli.sentinel.line-tune-off-and-refusal.why: Without it an off switch could still write settings, or one refused apply could stop the health pass that carries the board's other watches.

proves.claim: pullboard flow replay --tune over a seeded busy history prints the tuned and untuned runs, and the tuned median claim to landed is lower than the untuned one.

cli.journeys-flow-tune.busy-board-tuned-.why: Without it the line tuner's default could be turned on with no proof on the replay bench that the tuned line is faster.

proves.claim: pullboard flow replay --tune over a seeded one-seat history leaves no stage median of the tuned run higher than the untuned run.

cli.journeys-flow-tune.one-seat-no-stage.why: Without it tuning could make a board with one seat slower and nothing would show it before the default is turned on.
